title: Ghost Trace Sub-benchmark 1 run manifest
description: Per-RUN_ID artifact emitted by infra/docker/run-sub-benchmark-1.sh. Captures inputs, parameters, per-step status, and the verdict surface. manifest_version 'f6-operational-v0.1' is an operational placeholder per decision-log §0205: the F6 substrate-read contract (§0143 month 4-5 architecture artifact) is not yet drafted; this structure materializes F6 operationally pending formalization. The F6 RFC, when it lands, may adopt this format, adapt it, or supersede it — the operational tier does not pre-bind the contractual tier.

manifest_version.description: F6 operational placeholder; pending the F6 contract per §0143.

run_id.description: Operator-or-auto RUN_ID; defaults to UTC timestamp YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.

git_commit.description: Repository HEAD sha at the moment of `make run`; 'unknown' when git unavailable in the host shell.

image_digest.description: sha256 digest of the runtime image used for this run; 'unknown' until populated by an operator-side post-process.

by_source.description: Multi-source preparedness per §0205 refinement (b): cic_ids slot is populated this scope; synthetic + honeypot slots are present as null today and expected to populate in §0205+ frontes 2 and 3. Schema migration on those landings is avoided by reserving the slots now.

blake3_declared.description: Operator-declared BLAKE3 hex; empty string when not declared.

synthetic.description: Reserved for §0205+ Frente 2; null this scope.

honeypot.description: Reserved for §0205+ Frente 3; null this scope.

formation_top_n.description: Top-N cut for formation step; recorded even though formation is deferred to §0206 (so §0206 manifests inherit the same parameter shape).

t_b.description: T_B Layer B parameter as rational pair per §0138 + §0140.

included_steps.description: Pipeline steps executed by this scaffold revision.

deferred_steps.description: Pipeline steps named but not executed; tracked so manifests across scaffold revisions remain comparable.

signatures.description: Per-signature §0163 envelopes verbatim from each find-* CLI's stdout. Keys: automation_group_browser, automation_group_network, behavioral_cluster, campaign_hypothesis, coordination_ring. Each value is either the full envelope object {signature_name, candidate_count, candidates[], stats{...}} or null when the upstream CLI produced no parseable output.

ingest_report.description: Verbatim cic_ids.Report JSON emitted by the ingest step (cmd/ingest-cic-ids) to its stdout. Per §0211 timing instrumentation: carries rows_parsed, rows_rejected, observations_committed, ip_asn_emitted, tcp_fingerprint_emitted, flow_statistics_dropped, optional_fields_coerced_to_zero, ingest_started_at, ingest_completed_at, elapsed_ns. null when the ingest step did not run or emitted no parseable JSON.

derive_attributions_report.description: Verbatim payload JSON emitted by the derive-attributions step (cmd/derive-actor-attribution) to its stdout. Per §0211 timing instrumentation: carries definition_version, definition_parameters, examined, skipped, newly_derived, already_derived, derive_started_at, derive_completed_at, elapsed_ns. null when the derive step did not run or emitted no parseable JSON.

formations_report.description: Per §0213: verbatim outputPayload JSON emitted by the form-from-candidates step (cmd/form-automation-group-from-candidate) to its stdout. Carries ranking_algorithm, top_n, candidates_ingested, candidates_automation_group_eligible, cross_subtype_skipped, formations_committed[], already_present_count. null when the form-from-candidates step did not run or emitted no parseable JSON. The formations_committed array is the §0213 candidacy-materialization audit surface.

promotions_report.description: Per §0213: array of verbatim payload JSONs from each promote-automation-group invocation. One entry per formation hash emitted by formations_report.formations_committed. Each entry carries formation_event_hash + promotion_event_hash + cadence_seconds + already_promoted + layer_b_enabled. Empty array when no formations were committed (e.g., zero AG candidates in the input envelope).

morphology_report.description: Per §0216: verbatim emissionEnvelope JSON emitted by the measure-chain-morphology step (cmd/measure-chain-morphology) to its stdout. Carries {hypotheses[], stats{}} where hypotheses[] has per-hypothesis (hypothesis_hash_hex, subtype_name, actor_refs, chain_depth_max, chain_breadth_at_root, closure_count, source_event_count, formation_at) and stats{} has aggregate (total_formations, per_subtype, depth_histogram, breadth_histogram, chains_fracas_count, chains_fortes_count) per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 definition (chains-fracas = depth_max <= 2 OR breadth_at_root <= 3; chains-fortes = depth_max > 2 AND breadth_at_root > 3). null when the measure-chain-morphology step did not run or emitted no parseable JSON. Per §0216 + §0143 D2 audit-trail discipline: morphology_report contains ALL Cat III formations in substrate for audit completeness (including the 10 broken-chain historical preserved per §2.1); Sub-benchmark 1 comprovação claim applies to the clean-chain subset only (formations with source_event_count > 0).

demotions_report.description: Per §0216: array of verbatim payload JSONs from each demote-automation-group invocation. One entry per clean-chain promotion (shell-filtered via formations_report.formations_committed[].source_hashes_count > 0 per §0216 + §0143 D2 audit-trail discipline; broken-chain promotions excluded from demotion candidacy evaluation). Each entry carries promotion_event_hash + demotion_event_hash + already_demoted + cadence_satisfied + cadence_elapsed_seconds + layer_b (inline Layer B verdict per cliutil.LayerBPayload). Empty array when no clean-chain promotions were available.

step_durations.description: Per-step wall-clock duration in nanoseconds as observed by the orchestrator's invoke() wrapper. Per §0211: distinct from the CLI-internal elapsed_ns inside ingest_report / derive_attributions_report — step_durations measures process-launch + CLI-internal + process-teardown total (the operationally-relevant cost), while elapsed_ns measures the CLI function body alone. Both axes are preserved because they answer different questions (orchestrator overhead vs. library cost). Per §0213: form_from_candidates + promote_formations array entries added for the candidacy-materialization steps. Per §0216: measure_chain_morphology + demote_formations array entries added for the candidacy-evaluation steps.

promote_formations.description: Per §0213: one entry per promote-automation-group invocation; nanoseconds wall-clock per promotion. Index parallels promotions_report. Empty array when no formations were committed.

demote_formations.description: Per §0216: one entry per demote-automation-group invocation; nanoseconds wall-clock per demotion. Index parallels demotions_report. Empty array when no clean-chain promotions were available for demotion.

total_candidates.description: Sum of candidate_count across all signatures.

instrumented_non_firing.description: True when total_candidates == 0; per §0162 reachability-claim discipline this is a valid epistemic outcome with per-signature EvaluationStats remaining inspectable in the signatures.* sub-objects.

demotion_fired.description: Per §0216: boolean aggregate over demotions_report[].layer_b.fired. true if ANY clean-chain demotion's Layer B fired; false if all not-fired; null only when demotions_report is empty AND clean-chain promotions were not even attempted (degenerate path). Per §0216 + §0143 D2 audit-trail discipline: the aggregation considers ONLY clean-chain demotions (the demotions_report set, which is shell-filtered to source_event_count > 0 formations); broken-chain formations preserved per §2.1 but excluded from comprovação claim.

non_firing_diagnosis_axis.description: Pointers to the values already captured elsewhere in this manifest that constitute the §0143 mandatory instrumentation axis (subtype x source x chain-morphology). Per §0216: chain-morphology dimension now references morphology_report.stats for chains_fracas_count + chains_fortes_count per §0143 Sub-benchmark 1 definition.
